blocks.en: Corporations (corps) are the player-run organisations that form the foundation of EVE Online's social and strategic gameplay. Choosing the right corporation can significantly enhance a player’s experience in New Eden, offering community, guidance, and shared objectives. This page outlines how to find a corporation that fits a player’s goals and playstyle.
blocks.zh: 军团（corp）是由玩家运营的组织，是 EVE Online 社交与战略玩法的基础。选对军团能大大提升你在新伊甸的游戏体验，带来社群、指导和共同目标。本页介绍如何找到适合自己目标和玩法风格的军团。

blocks.en: While it is possible to play EVE Online solo, joining a corporation provides access to:
blocks.zh: 虽然 EVE Online 可以单人游玩，但加入军团可以获得：

en: Protection and support in hostile environments
zh: 共享的资源、舰队和基础设施
社交互动与团队协作
训练与导师指导
在危险环境中的保护和支援
成长和担任领导的机会

blocks.en: How to Search for a Corporation
Players can use several tools and channels to explore corporations:
blocks.zh: 玩家可以通过多种工具和渠道来了解军团：

en: In-Game Corporation Finder Tool: Found under the Social menu. Filters by activity, region, time zone, and size.
EVE Discord Servers and Reddit (EVE Online Discord, /r/evejobs subreddit)
Third-Party Tools: Sites like Eve Workbench and Dotlan can help evaluate corps and alliances.
zh: 游戏内军团查找工具：位于社交（Social）菜单下，可按活动类型、星域、时区和规模筛选。
EVE 论坛 – 军团与联盟招募版（链接）
EVE 相关 Discord 服务器和 Reddit（EVE Online Discord、/r/evejobs 子版块）
第三方工具：Eve Workbench 和 Dotlan 等网站可以帮助评估军团和联盟。

blocks.en: Before joining, it is advisable to research a corporation's:
blocks.zh: 加入之前，建议先了解军团的：

en: Activity level and time zone alignment
zh: 活跃程度，以及时区是否合适
规章与要求
沟通工具（Discord、Mumble、论坛等）
税率和可用的基础设施
文化氛围与领导风格

blocks.en: EVE University is a well-established training corporation dedicated to helping new and returning players learn all aspects of EVE Online. It offers:
blocks.zh: EVE University 是一个历史悠久的训练型军团，致力于帮助新玩家和回归玩家学习 EVE Online 的方方面面。它提供：

en: Access to fleets, mentorship, and shared infrastructure
No mandatory skillpoint or activity requirements
zh: 定期课程和问答（Q&A）活动
内容全面的 wiki
参加舰队、导师指导和共享基础设施
没有强制的技能点或活跃度要求
友好、包容的氛围

blocks.en: While we encourage our members to eventually "graduate" to other corporations or alliances, EVE University provides a strong foundation for any career in New Eden.
blocks.zh: 我们鼓励成员最终“毕业”加入其他军团或联盟，而 EVE University 能为你在新伊甸的任何职业道路打下坚实基础。

blocks.en: To apply, visit Join EVE University and connect to our public Discord.
blocks.zh: 申请加入请访问加入 EVE University，并连接我们的公开 Discord。

en: Attend a public fleet or event if available
Read any public websites, Discord, or recruitment posts
Be wary of vague or overly ambitious claims
Trust your instincts—culture fit is important
zh: 如果有公开舰队或活动，去参加一次
申请前多提问
阅读军团公开的网站、Discord 或招募帖
警惕含糊其辞或过于夸大的说法
相信自己的直觉——文化契合很重要

blocks.en: There is no penalty for leaving a corporation. Players may freely leave or switch corps at any time (except during certain war or alliance scenarios). Many players move through several corporations over the course of their EVE career as their goals and playstyle evolve.
blocks.zh: 离开军团没有任何惩罚。玩家可以随时自由退出或更换军团（某些战争或联盟情况下除外）。随着目标和玩法的变化，很多玩家在 EVE 生涯中会先后待过好几个军团。
